steps: Calls flow normally while classified outcomes remain healthy.
A rolling failure threshold opens the circuit and calls fail fast.
After a cool-down, a few half-open probes test recovery.
Successful probes close the circuit; failures reopen it.

lesson.scenario: A checkout client opens a circuit after repeated tax-service timeouts and probes recovery.

steps.title: Closed circuit
steps.narration: The recent window has one timeout in twenty calls.
steps.invariant: Only configured failure classes should count toward opening.

steps.title: Failures accumulate
steps.narration: Nine more tax calls time out inside the rolling window.
steps.invariant: The window needs enough volume to avoid opening on one isolated failure.

steps.title: Circuit opens
steps.narration: The breaker stops forwarding and schedules a probe in thirty seconds.
steps.outcome: Checkout avoids spending capacity on doomed calls.
steps.invariant: Open circuits fail fast but do not prove the dependency is still unhealthy.

steps.title: Half-open probe
steps.narration: At the deadline, exactly one trial request is admitted.
steps.outcome: The dependency is tested without releasing the full load.

steps.title: Circuit closes
steps.narration: The successful probe resets the breaker and normal traffic resumes.
steps.invariant: A failed probe would reopen the circuit and start a new delay.
